title: Acquirer: Brambles Industries Ltd; Target: Ausdoc Information Management Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Brambles intends to lodge an expression of interest for the purchase of Ausdoc Information Management, the records management business of The Ausdoc Group
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant markets appear to be: - the supply of physical record management services; - the supply of electronic information services; and - the supply of secure destruction services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Despite a high market share, the possible acquisition would not appear likely to substantially lessen competition because: - the merged entity will face continued competition from two companies able to compete for large business contracts, and numerous smaller competitors able to expand their operations were prices to rise; - barriers to entry appear to be low with low sunk entry costs and a growing market; - customers appear to have a degree of countervailing power which is significant in their initial choice of supplier; and - market dynamics, particularly technological development in the electronic information management market will continue to provide an important competitive constraint. The Commission therefore decided not to intervene in the possible acquisition.
